data: Which model has the highest Lipschitz constant at the end of training?

The question asks which model has the highest Lipschitz constant at the end of training. From the caption, we know that the blue line represents Batch Size 1, the green line represents Batch Size 5, and the red line represents Batch Size 30. In the second graph, which shows the robustness during training, the lines represent the same batch sizes. At the end of training, the red line (Batch Size 30) is the highest among the three lines. Therefore, the model with the highest Lipschitz constant at the end of training is Batch Size 30.
